games.name: MunchMiner
games.description: Dig into a side-view world, build a rail network, and turn the materials you bring home into toys for the evening market.
games.homeSummary: Put on the red helmet and work for Marksa, a would-be world conqueror with a village to look after. Shape tunnels, connect powered stations, and let their Dudu carts bring materials home. Back in town, turn your haul into toys, choose your stall's stock and work the evening crowd before planning the next expedition.
homeHighlights: Connect tracks, power and automatic freight
Learn recipes and run your toy stall
games.alt: MunchMiner's town, with a warmly lit workshop and its black-ball inhabitants
steps: Dig through soil and mineral deposits, open passages and shape the route you want to explore. The tunnels you make remain when you return.
Build stations and gathering facilities, then connect them with powered tracks. Each station's permanent Dudu automatically carries eligible materials along a valid delivery route.
Use delivered minerals and creature materials in the workshop. Assemble a first sample to learn a recipe, then produce batches and select finished toys for the stall.
Read toy requests, guide shoppers to your stall and collect payment after their toys are ready. Unsold stock stays with you for a future market.

games.name: Circuit Stance
games.description: Take the role of a super AI. Combine modular chips to program your robots, test your tactics in the arena, and refine your next strategy.
games.homeSummary: In this turn-based strategy roguelike, your plan begins with the robot's AI. Combine modular chip actions to build behaviours, take the result into the arena and watch how it performs. Each match gives you another chance to reconsider your choices; victories move you up the game's tiered ranking, while losses put the run under pressure.
homeHighlights: Build behaviours with modular AI chips
Test tactical choices in the arena
Rework your build and pursue a higher rank
games.alt: Circuit Stance chip-board preparation captured from the current official Steam release trailer
steps: Choose chip actions, arrange them on the hexagonal board and select a battle stance. Build around the behaviour you want to test.
Take that setup into a tactical arena match. Observe the combatants, their chip boards and the changing health bars to see how the plan performs.
Return to your build with a new question: what should change for the next encounter? Experiment with combinations, test the result and work toward a higher rank.
